G3_Android_Native_Build_Feasibility_Veri.reason: Android arm64-v8a minSdk 26 / targetSdk 37 compatibility and Windows portable JDK 17 + Gradle 8.10.2 + Android SDK 35 toolchain verified. However, C++ native compilation requires Linux CI (or F-Droid binary extraction in P1) and NDK 29 is not yet installed locally.

G4_DOCX_Engine_Feasibility_Verified.reason: 23/25 DOCX features verified directly in Collabora Writer (COKit + LOActivity + PrintAdapter), with 2/25 (Room Recent Files & in-place SAF Rename) designed in Kotlin shared core, and 4/4 DOCX test corpus files verified.

G5_XLSX_Engine_Feasibility_Verified.reason: All XLSX features and 9 formulas (SUM, AVERAGE, COUNT, COUNTA, IF, SUMIF, COUNTIF, VLOOKUP, XLOOKUP) are verified in upstream Collabora Calc C++ source and P0 OOXML test corpus, but live on-device formula recalculation on the physical Android 16 phone is pending P1 prototype execution.

G6_Offline_and_Privacy_Feasibility_Verif.reason: In-process FakeSocket.cpp and COWebViewClient.java prove 100% server-less offline operation. Identified and designed surgical fixes to strip INTERNET and MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE permissions, disable cloud backup, scrub cache temp files, and lock down implicit broadcasts.

G7_Performance_Baseline_Established.reason: APK size baseline (242.61 MB arm64-v8a) and host OOXML round-trip timings across 7 test documents are logged in corpus_verification_log.json. On-device Android 16 cold/warm start, render latency, and RAM/CPU profiling are pending P1 APK build and physical device connection.

G8_Rollback_and_Reproducibility_Verified.reason: Zero modifications made to Windows system config, WSL, Ollama, Eurowindow AI Studio, or PersonalPDFStudio. All P0 outputs are isolated inside F:\word và Excel with deterministic corpus generation and full rollback documentation.
